cards.name: Blur Glitch
cards.summary: Meant to smear the whole line in and out of blur: a wiggle(7, 100) expression on the animator's Blur drives horizontal and vertical blur independently about 7 times a second. In the gallery render (applied at 0 s) both sampled frames, 0.5 s and 1.4 s, were pixel-identical to the plain text with no blur at all, so the blur is intermittent at best (negative wiggle values clamp to 0) or not evaluating: scrub it before relying on it.
use_for: Glitchy title for a tech / AI explainer hook
'Fake news' or 'breaking' style caption in a political reel
Short glitch beat on a trailer title
avoid: Unverified: the gallery render showed no blur at 0.5 s or 1.4 s; scrub the layer, or raise the Blur base value so the wiggle stays positive, before using it
Same blur on every character (the range selector covers the whole line): it reads as a focus glitch, not a per-letter glitch
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: a wiggle(7, 100) expression on Blur runs for the whole layer, so comp.time does not matter; the gallery render caught it sharp at both 0.5 s and 1.4 s.
cards.scripting: comp.time does not matter (no keyframes). applyPreset acts on the SELECTED layers of the comp (it makes a new solid if none is selected), so deselect all, set target.selected = true, then target.applyPreset(new File(<batch 'file' path>)). Needs a TextLayer: on other layers the text animators do not apply. To calm it, edit the wiggle(7, 100) expression on 'Blur Glitch Animator' > Blur (lower the second number) or trim the layer.

verified.note: Both frames (0.5 s and 1.4 s) are pixel-identical to the plain white text: no blur at all, so the wiggle(7, 100) blur was either clamped to 0 at both samples or did not evaluate.
